tasks.title: Nyquist frequency
tasks.statement: The gyro is sampled at **{f} kHz**. What is the highest signal frequency (Hz) that can be represented without aliasing?
tasks.solution: f_max = f_s/2. Anything above “folds” into the band below and looks like low-frequency noise.

tasks.title: Filter delay
tasks.statement: A first-order filter with a cutoff frequency of **{fc} Hz**. Estimate the group delay at low frequencies (ms): τ = 1/(2π·f_c).
tasks.solution: τ = 1/(2π f_c). A 100 Hz cutoff gives 1.6 ms; every extra filter adds its share.
